title: normalize_text: normalize case in one text column
description: Convert the values in one text column to lower case, upper case, or title case.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The text column to normalize. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: case
parameters.description: Case normalization mode. Allowed values: lower, upper, title.

rag_note: Use normalize_text when the user asks to standardize text casing. It modifies one existing column and does not create new columns.
